definition: Completely defeated or overcome by another person or force.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: He felt himself vanquished on all sides, but he felt at the same time that what he wanted to say was unintelligible to his brother.
example_sentence: The vanquished team trudged off the pitch in silence.
